newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade very slow - USDA.

text.p: Kansas on Wednesday, USDA said. Not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 85900 head confirmed including 29800 head or about 35 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
week to date: 85900 week ago: 60000 year ago: 72900
Slaughter Heifers few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
